title: Rainwater Collection
description: Shows how to estimate collection from your roof, the parts of a system (catchment, gutters, first-flush diverter, storage, overflow), and how to install one barrel or link several. Covers tarp and improvised collection, treating rainwater to drink, maintenance, legal limits, and winterizing.
shortDescription: Size a catchment, build a rain barrel system, and make rainwater drinkable
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
